name: SemanticPOSS — Point Cloud Segmentation in Crowded Environments
description: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation benchmark released by Peking University focusing on dynamic agents in crowded campus environments. Recorded using a 40-beam Hesai Pandar40 LiDAR mounted on an autonomous low-speed vehicle across Peking University campus. Contains 2,988 high-density LiDAR scans with fine-grained point-wise semantic labels across 14 categories, specifically emphasizing dynamic road agents, pedestrians, cyclists, and campus traffic furniture.
